name: bezen
description: BEZEN — an authentic Hebrew emotional-intelligence layer for AI agents. Tools that make a model write and read Hebrew the way Israelis actually speak, instead of translated American English.

plugins.name: bezen-stories
plugins.description: Write a Hebrew interactive story built around one human pattern, or score a story another model wrote. Rebuilds a familiar story (Little Red Riding Hood, Goldilocks) around a single emotional pattern in present-day Israeli reality, with reader choices and a twist that re-reads everything before it. Includes a 4-axis rubric for comparing models on Israeli concreteness, emotional restraint, twist strength, and who owns the insight — the text or the reader.

plugins.name: bezen-songs
plugins.description: Read raw Hebrew song lyrics a person wrote and prepare them for composing — without rewriting them. Returns the emotional pattern, the three strongest lines quoted word for word, what to cut, a chorus built only from the writer's own lines, two sticky hooks, chords per section, and a ready Suno prompt. Ships a verifier script that rejects any quote, fix or hook that is not the writer's own.
